notes.title: The game will continue to make large-step development
notes.content:
Recently, updates will no longer be used for details, visuals, sound effects, but will be greatly changed and added.
In the original plan, this is a unique mechanism driven game. But in the current EA version, the completion of the game is too low, and the details and balance are not good. Sales volume and evaluation are very low. It must be admitted that a lot of factors are due to the anxiety of development funds, so the sale is too early and the test is not sufficient. In the near future, I will carefully think about and make the following content to solve these problems. There will be a lot of changes and additions to the game.

After the release of version 0.20, I hope this framework has become rich.
Thank you for buying. I hope my later work will be enough to repay your support.
We look forward to your further feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: I'm sorry to use the special UI design, which is being improved
notes.content:
I've designed a very rare interactive panel that integrates all the information displayed. Click to lock. It's slow to adapt, but it makes me feel simple. I'm passionate about innovation, I'm used to this kind of design, but I ignore the players' ideas.
You may adapt. Or may make you feel unaccustomed and affect the game experience.
This problem will improve rapidly in 0.10c in 2 days.

I've been taking this game seriously, hoping to make everyone satisfied and myself proud. I've persisted for a long time and will continue to work hard. It's not "I haven't played" or "close eyes design". It makes me a little sad.
I will seriously reflect on my own design ideas. You are also welcome to continue to point out the shortcomings of the game and make it better.
Forgive me. Sorry again!

Developer Nianless
